scope: Exact source-target pairs in owned NativeArchives, NativeSlides, PDFOffice and NativeOCR supports/conversion routes, plus explicitly named portable component fixtures. Not whole-app compatibility matrix.

status_definitions.portable_helper_pass: Executed production portable logic, not full macOS route.
status_definitions.mac_only_untested: Requires macOS framework execution; portable component status is separately recorded.
status_definitions.untested: Implementation route exists but this exact pair has not executed.

archive_capability_findings.rar: Offered unconditionally; BSD tar/libarchive may decode supported RAR variants without third-party apps. No RAR fixture tested. Unsupported/encrypted variants can fail.
archive_capability_findings.seven_zip: PASS portable fixture via libarchive 3.7.2 7zip writer and production extractor, no third-party 7z executable. macOS stock BSD tar remains untested; compression/encryption variants may differ.
archive_capability_findings.bz2: PASS portable plain-stream fixture with /usr/bin/bzip2 fallback installed. Offered unconditionally; fallback executable is checked inside extraction, not supports.
archive_capability_findings.xz: PASS portable plain-stream fixture with /usr/bin/xz fallback installed. macOS standalone xz is not guaranteed. Offered unconditionally; fallback executable is checked inside extraction, not supports.
archive_capability_findings.recommendation: Do not label RAR/7z categorically third-party-required. Mark runtime codec-dependent. For bz2/xz, system libarchive may already decode the source; gating solely on standalone decoder existence can hide working routes.
